sections.h2: Tips for booking a hotel in York
sections.html:
• Stay central and walk. Most sights are inside or close to the city walls, so a central hotel saves taxis.
  • Watch the calendar. Race meetings at York Racecourse and the Christmas season are popular, so prices can rise. Compare a few dates if you can.
  • Driving? Central parking is limited. Check whether your hotel has parking, or use the Park & Ride.

faqs.q: Is it worth staying inside York’s city walls?
faqs.a: If you want to walk everywhere, yes. Hotels just outside the walls, or near the station, can be better value and are still only a short walk from the centre.
